relationships.subject: capsazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared with the vehicle, capsazepine decreased both the flinching and licking times exhibited by CFA rats at 2 min after the injection (P<0.05).

relationships.subject: P2X3
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunoblotting with an anti-TRPV1 antibody revealed a strong P2X3-immunoreactive band (Figure 3(a)), and immunoblotting with an anti-P2X3 antibody revealed a strong TRPV1-immunoreactive band (Figure 3(b))

relationships.subject: P2X3
relationships.evidence_quote: which indicated that P2X3 inhibited the effect of TRPV1 under both physiological and pathological conditions

key_findings: P2X3 and TRPV1 co-immunoprecipitate and are co-expressed in small and medium DRG neurons in SNI and CFA rats
P2X3-TRPV1 interactions differ between inflammatory (mutual inhibition in vitro) and neuropathic pain (P2X3 facilitates TRPV1; TRPV1 inhibits P2X3)
